title: Aether-Render: Graph-Based Rasterization Engine for GPU Vector Graphics
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present Aether-Render, a Python-based GPU vector graphics engine that constructs a directed acyclic rendering graph and executes it via a network-flow style scheduler. The engine guarantees that each rendering pass is processed in topological order, preserving invariant safety while achieving an asymptotic traversal cost of $O(|V|+|E|)$ and a flow-optimization cost of $O((|V|+|E|)\log |V|)$. Formal proofs establish that the graph remains acyclic after each insertion and that the cumulative weight of all edges is bounded by $|E|\cdot W_{\max}$. The implementation is verified through static abstract syntax tree inspection and structural complexity profiling on an AMD EPYC 9V74 platform.
